messages:
sam: quick thought on the regen diffs UI — per-row primary 'Approve' feels heavy for big runs. what if we collapse to a single toolbar CTA and use checkboxes per row?
jamie: agree. toolbar CTA labeled 'Approve selected' and disabled unless rows selected. show count: '3 selected'.
lisa: accessibility: ensure DOM order so toolbar is reachable right after the list. aria-live (polite) should announce '3 of 12 selected'. checkboxes must be operable via keyboard (space) and have 44px hit targets.
ron: copy nit: current modal title 'Are you sure?' is vague. propose: title 'Approve 3 outputs' body 'This will accept 3 outputs for this eval run. Undo available from the toast for 15s. You can also revert individual outputs from run history.' primary: 'Approve 3 outputs' secondary: 'Cancel'.
sam: UX detail — for small selects (<5) consider inline confirm (sheet) instead of full modal; modal for larger batches. keeps flow lightweight.
lisa: inline confirm must still meet accessibility: role=dialog, trap focus when open, and have accessible label.
jamie: frontend: debounce approve action and disable CTA while request in flight. spinner in CTA is fine. also throttle duplicate keyboard submits (500ms).
ron: variant pill idea: show small model variant badge on each row (abbr inside pill). on focus/hover reveal full model name in accessible tooltip. keep pill tiny (12px height).
sam: compact view: toggle that collapses unchanged context and shows expandable hunks. default to compact for runs > 10 diffs. ensure chevrons have aria-expanded and large hit area.
lisa: copy tweak for scorecards: switch 'Pass / Fail' -> 'Meets threshold / Needs review' to reduce binary language.
jamie: color contrast: primary CTA blue #1e6fd8 is ~3.9:1 on 13px. need 4.5:1. options: darken to #0b52a8 or increase font-weight. prefer darker token. also add non-color focus ring (outline + offset).
ron: undo UX: toast should be role=alert saying '3 outputs approved — Undo' with a focusable Undo button. TTL 15s. store server-side bulk-action id to map undo.
lisa: keyboard shortcut: Shift+A to approve selected (open confirm). SR should announce 'Approve shortcut activated'. document in shortcuts modal.
sam: question: per-output undo vs bulk? bulk undo is simpler; allow per-output revert in run history if needed.
jamie: agrees. per-output undo in timeline, bulk undo via toast.
ux-bot: Reminder: design review 2024-12-02 10:00am PT. Agenda: toolbar relocation, compact view rules, inline vs modal confirm, aria-live phrasing, contrast token update, undo mapping.
sam: thanks all I'll prep annotated mocks and a short keyboard-flow spec after the review. :thumbsup:
